GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 014.33 (23 Aug 46) GC
(SCAPIN-1151)
APO 500
23 August 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Repatriation of Ryukyuans now in Japan.
1． Reference is made to memorandum from the Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, file AG014.33 (24 Jul 46)GC, (SCAPIN-1081), dated 24 July 1946, subject as above.
2． So much of paragraph 4a of reference paragraph 1 above as reads, "..to Koniya, Amami Oshima" is changed to read, "...to Naze, Amami Oshima."
3． The Imperial Japanese Government will outload Ryukyuan repatriates as prescribed in paragraph 4 of reference paragraph 1 above, as amended herein.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
